You'll establish CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and introduce containerization where it adds value. You'll help choose the tools and approach that fit our stage of growth. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams foster innovation and drive better solutions for our customers.

Align learning strategy, instructional approach, operational requirements, and user experience throughout the delivery lifecycle. Balance speed and quality to deliver sustainable solutions that can be maintained, scaled, and improved over time. Define and track learning and delivery KPIs that demonstrate adoption, effectiveness, learner experience, operational impact, and squad performance. Use data, user feedback, and business outcomes to evaluate training performance and identify improvement opportunities. Turn insights into backlog decisions, product enhancements, and clear recommendations for stakeholders. Promote evidence-based decision-making and a test-and-learn approach across the learning portfolio. Build trusted relationships with business leaders, customers, functional partners, and delivery teams. Experience as a Project Analyst, Product Owner, Project Coordinator, Project Lead, or in a comparable role with end-to-end ownership of priorities and outcomes. Demonstrated experience working with Agile methodologies and multidisciplinary squads. Practical experience managing a backlog, prioritising demand, and translating stakeholder needs into executable work. Experience in corporate training development, learning management systems, or digital learning solutions is advantageous. Technical Strength Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. Capability in product management, backlog management, prioritisation, and roadmapping. Solid project management skills, with the ability to manage scope, timing, dependencies, risks, and quality. Experience with Agile work management tools such as Monday.com, Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Planner, or equivalent platforms. Ability to define and monitor training KPIs and use learning data to guide decisions. Confidence analysing performance metrics, learner feedback, adoption data, and business outcomes. Mindset & Behaviours Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day priorities with broader business outcomes. Clear, confident communicator who can influence stakeholders and simplify complex needs. Skilled negotiator who can align stakeholders around value-based trade-offs. Collaborative leader who creates clarity, trust, accountability, and autonomy within the squad.
